remarks: Mill Bridge is an English Tudor, highly sought after complex, across from a golf course, near downtown, yet has a serene European feel. This 2 bedroom 2 full-bath townhouse with private entrance is nestled among English gardens, brick-laid walkways & park-like grounds. This unit is in the back, facing the lovely Mill River and grassy banks with picnic area. This townhouse features an open floor plan, and as you step inside, you'll be greeted by a spacious and inviting living room, complete with a cozy wood-burning fireplace. The living room flows seamlessly into the dining area and the kitchen looks out to the tree filled backyard. The two bedrooms are both generously sized and plenty of natural light. The primary bedroom features an en-suite bathroom and the second bedroom features vaulted ceilings. Other features of this lovely pet friendly condo include a one-car garage parking space, newer HVAC, a new roof, and an abundance of storage.
